DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string. Add a Railway Postgres service to auto-inject.

DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encryption key for sensitive data stored in the database (32 characters). Auto-generated.

VITE_BASE_URL.description: Public URL of your deployment (e.g., https://your-app.up.railway.app). Required for cookies and callbacks.

SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for signing JWT tokens. Auto-generated.

WHITELISTED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated allowed CORS origins. Include your Railway public URL.
